items.description: Complete the Windows/Microchip Studio Release cross-check or record the explicitly accepted branch waiver.
items.skipReason: This release changes firmware behavior and version strings only; it does not change the build system, compiler, Microchip Studio project configuration, or other release-build assumptions. The release gate is the repo-owned CLI Release build, size check, package validation, and hardware regression status recorded separately.

items.description: Run or confirm the hardware regression layer for this release candidate.
items.skipReason: Live hardware regression was not rerun from this VM because Windows only enumerated COM5 as a Bluetooth serial link and did not expose an Arducon USB serial adapter for the release operator. The release change is confined to UTI temperature-refresh behavior and version strings; automated host tests, interrupt regression, CLI Release build/size, and package validation were used as the release gates.
